item.text: I’ll build the circular flange and hollow stem as one solid, then compare the four views and export the STEP file.

arguments.code:
flange_d = 100.0
stem_d = 40.0
bore_d = 27.0
stem_length = 50.0
flange_thickness = 6.0
stem = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(stem_d / 2).extrude(stem_length)
flange = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=stem_length).circle(flange_d / 2).extrude(flange_thickness)
body = stem.union(flange)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(bore_d / 2).extrude(stem_length + flange_thickness)
result = body.cut(bore)
arguments.label: Circular flange with tubular stem
